entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Muslim League, a political institution in Pakistan during British Raj and Pakistan Movement (1930–1947). Grew from All-India Muslim League founded at Dhaka and Syed Ahmad Khan. Led to the emergence of Pakistan Movement and Creation and Lahore Resolution — Muslim League formally demands the creation of Pakistan.
